blocks.orig: This is a beautiful combination of a hike in the untamed nature of the Great Rift Valley and a cultural tour in the nearby Mto wa Mbu. During the hike, you enjoy beautiful views over Lake Manyara National Park and see many birds, monkeys and other forest animals. In the village Mto wa Mbu your guide teaches you more about local life, while you stroll through the village and pass by banana plantations and a school.
blocks.html: This tour pairs a hike through the untamed nature of the Great Rift Valley with a cultural visit to nearby Mto wa Mbu. On the hike you get lovely views of Lake Manyara National Park and see plenty of birds, monkeys and other forest animals. In the village of Mto wa Mbu your guide tells you more about daily life there as you walk through the village, past banana plantations and a school.
